findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/workflow-convergence-failure-remediation-execution-plan.md:114-123,545-564,615-646 — medium: the #7/B-8195 outcome and boundary are not actually recorded. The only new text places routine-validate writer closeout inside Workstream A even though 6.1 says that workstream owns C1 only; the landing-order table still lists only five stories and the exit criterion still says all five stories. Add a bounded implemented-contract/status entry (or an explicit interposed follow-up row) naming B-8195, its one-shot TEST-transition/CLI-terminal closeout result, verifier-entry fail-closed boundary, and non-goals, without implying C1/DONE-required scope absorbed routine validate.
findings.resolvedReason: Commit 94a0085b13 adds explicit section 6A for interposed #7/B-8195, records the one-shot reused PASS outcome and strict verifier-entry boundary, lists non-goals, and updates landing order, verification matrix, metrics, and exit criteria from five to six stories.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:1250-1258,1382: HIGH — the new canonical terminal closeout throws on transaction failure, but writeCodexProcessEvent catches that error and only reports a health issue; run() then continues to print the original successful validate/story_advance result and exits 0. A commit-hook/CAS/persistence failure can therefore publish a reused PASS while its terminal audit closeout failed, directly violating the story contract that persistence failure must never report PASS or require a blind retry. Make closeout failure part of the command result/exit path while avoiding recursive error-event writes, or perform the required terminal closeout inside a transaction whose failure the caller cannot swallow.
findings.resolvedReason: Commit 94a0085 makes writeCodexProcessEvent throw CanonicalTerminalCloseoutError for successful TEST/validate closeout failures; run() catches it, suppresses recursive error-event writing, prints no original success payload, and exits 1. Focused smoke covers injected terminal commit failure and passed.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/auto-commit-metadata.ts:239-247 with packages/main/src/core/done-prepare-generated-metadata.ts:450-460: HIGH — the concurrent HEAD/content mismatch branches call rollbackDonePrepareGeneratedMetadataTransaction, which unconditionally restores capture-time bytes and index entries. If another writer changes one of these canonical paths after verifiedHashes are recorded, detection succeeds but rollback erases that competing write; a concurrent commit touching the path is likewise overwritten in the worktree. This contradicts CHK-002/003 preservation guarantees. Rollback must be compare-and-restore, only undoing bytes still equal to this transaction output; otherwise leave competing bytes untouched and return a classified conflict. Add a deterministic content-race test for this lifecycle wrapper.
findings.resolvedReason: Commit 94a0085 replaces unconditional rollback with compare-and-restore: only writer-owned verified bytes are restored; divergent worktree bytes and real-index state are preserved and classified. Deterministic lifecycle content/index race cases are included in the focused smoke, which passed.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:1382-1411: MEDIUM — the new codex_cli terminal event is committed before postCommand hooks run. A configured postCommand hook that appends canonical process metadata runs afterward and leaves process-events.jsonl dirty even though story_advance/validate exits successfully, so the next mandatory validate can still hit the exact canonical-dirty failure this story claims to eliminate. Move terminal closeout to the true end of the successful command after postCommand hooks, or explicitly close and prove hook output under a bounded writer contract; add a production-entrypoint hook-order regression.
findings.resolvedReason: Commit 94a0085 defers successful validate/story_advance(TEST) codex terminal capture and closeout until after postCommand hooks. Hook-created canonical dirt now makes the final clean-baseline capture fail nonzero instead of surviving past closeout; focused production-entrypoint hook regression passed.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:1238-1253,1382-1398 — HIGH: the new Codex terminal transaction is committed before `postCommand` hooks run. A configured postCommand hook can append/mutate process-events.jsonl after the exact-path commit, so story_advance TEST still returns success with canonical metadata dirty and the immediately following validate repeats the canonical-pass-persistence-failed loop. This violates CHK-002 adversarial:1 / CHK-003 adversarial:2. Run hooks before the terminal capture/write/commit, or include their completion inside a final exact-delta boundary and add a production-path postCommand mutation regression.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by 94a0085b13: cli-engine.ts now completes postCommand hooks before capturing/appending/committing the canonical terminal row (lines 1410-1455). The production-path postCommand mutation regression asserts nonzero outcome, preserves foreign bytes, and never prints PASS; focused validation-evidence-reuse smoke passed this scenario.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:1250-1258 — HIGH: failure of the new canonical terminal commit is thrown and immediately swallowed by the surrounding catch, which only records a best-effort health issue; run() then prints the original validate/story_advance result and exits success. A CAS/hook/signing/index-refresh/rollback failure can therefore be reported as PASS despite missing or partial canonical terminal persistence, contrary to the must requirement that persistence failures be classified and never publish false PASS. Propagate a structured failure to run() (while avoiding recursive terminal writes) and cover the failure path.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by 94a0085b13: writeCodexProcessEvent rethrows terminal closeout failure as CanonicalTerminalCloseoutError (lines 1279-1287), outer run catch suppresses recursive terminal writing and exits 1 without printing the original PASS (lines 1491-1503). The postCommand closeout-failure regression verifies nonzero exit and no PASS stdout.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/auto-commit-metadata.ts:234-253 — MEDIUM: `commitLifecycleMetadataTransaction` promises rollback on every commit/concurrency failure, but the HEAD read and managed-file digest reads execute outside its try/catch. A git read failure or filesystem race throws past `rollback`, leaving the transition/terminal bytes dirty and bypassing the function's classified `{ok:false}` contract. Enclose all post-write verification in the rollback guard and add a deterministic injected read/CAS failure test for this lifecycle-specific writer.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by 94a0085b13: all post-write HEAD/digest/immutable-commit verification is inside commitLifecycleMetadataTransaction's try/catch (lines 287-328); readLifecycleMetadataOutputHashes classifies filesystem reads, and compare-and-restore preserves concurrent bytes/index state. Focused transaction tests cover writer failure, content race, HEAD CAS, and read failure.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/validation-evidence-reuse-smoke.ts:138-168,386-457,1001-1017 — HIGH coverage gap: the new lifecycle transactions introduced in transition-orchestrator.ts:676-749 and cli-engine.ts:1210-1252 are exercised only on their happy path plus pre-entry human/forged process-event dirt. The CAS/HEAD race, phase-hook content mutation, commit failure, exact 3-path/1-path admission, rollback restoration, and unrelated source/config/command-entry controls recorded for CHK-002 edge:1/edge:2/adversarial:1 and CHK-003 adversarial:1/adversarial:2 still run only against the older validation-reuse 3-file writer, not either new lifecycle caller/helper. Also CHK-003 edge:0 merely checks the counter on the second validate; it never snapshots HEAD, process-event count, receipt count, or canonical status to prove no duplicate facts/receipts and stable cleanup. Add deterministic tests for both new transaction kinds/call sites (including hook mutation and rollback byte/index preservation), assert exact commit path sets, and strengthen repeated-idempotence assertions before treating all 20 must intents as covered.
findings.resolvedReason: Commit 94a0085b13 adds deterministic exact 3-path and 1-path lifecycle transaction tests, owned-byte/index rollback on writer failure, concurrent content and HEAD CAS preservation, output-read failure, forged pre-entry rejection, real postCommand and onPhaseChange hook mutation caller tests, plus repeated validate HEAD/event/receipt/final-clean assertions. Focused validation-evidence-reuse smoke passes.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:1410-1421 — MEDIUM: the new `canonicalCommandFailure` branch suppresses `writeCodexProcessEvent` entirely for routine validate results with status/allPass failure. These are structured handler failures that historically return without throwing, so they never reach the error-path writer either; the durable `codex_cli` audit row is silently lost, contradicting this function’s documented both-success-and-error choke-point contract. Emit a failure terminal row (and close it safely if a clean canonical boundary is required) rather than skipping the event; add a structured validate-failure assertion.
